title: MD-B01 scope, product, time-boundary, and policy-leakage revalidation against current authority
objective: Revalidate existing implementation against the frozen W01 scope: no ambiguity in market, product, or time boundary, and no watchlist policy leakage into the market-data surface.

policy_vocabulary_adequacy.concern: The vocabulary is the load-bearing part of five naming guards. Too narrow and all five report clean while policy names sit in the schema.
policy_vocabulary_adequacy.defect_found_and_fixed_during_this_attem: The first vocabulary missed ranked_picks, one of the boundary contract own forbidden examples, because a bare rank alternative does not match the morphological variant ranked.
policy_vocabulary_adequacy.self_verification: test_the_policy_vocabulary_matches_the_contract_examples_in_both_directions asserts the matcher catches all five forbidden examples the contract names, clears all six valid examples it names, and clears five overloaded upstream names.
policy_vocabulary_adequacy.overloaded_token_handling: candidate, signal, execution, long, short, target, and position are excluded as bare tokens per Domain_Boundary_Invariants_LOCKED.md, which requires such a guard to check the surrounding contract rather than the token. A separate compound pattern catches trade_candidates and buy_candidate while leaving candidate_publication_id and range_position_20_pct clean.

rules_deliberately_not_claimed.reason: seven of the eight enumerated surfaces are covered by executed guards, but "positive feature definitions" is not a name check and is not proven. Claiming the rule would overstate the evidence.
the eligible/data_usable half is proven; the point-in-time instrument, trade date, and publication context half belongs to MD-B16 and MD-B17.

adj_close exclusion is proven; "not mixed with close across one vector" and "one run one versioned basis" belong to MD-B12 and MD-B14, and BarPriceProductIdentityTest is currently disabled by a dead path.
the never-backdated half is proven; consecutive SLO measurement belongs to MD-B19.
RAW as a distinct product code is proven; canonical validation of the series belongs to MD-B09.

test_suite_execution.note: The 133 remaining failures are owned by MD-B03, MD-B06, MD-B10, MD-B12, MD-B14, MD-B15, MD-B17, MD-B18, MD-B19, MD-B21, and MD-B22 under F-MD-B00-A001-001. No MD-B01-owned test fails.

documentation_integrity_gate.note: The gate correctly FAILED mid-attempt when MD-B01-A001-BL001 existed on disk but was not yet registered, and returned to PASS once registered. That transition is itself evidence the registry completeness check is live.

residue_verdict.basis: One dead path rebound and guarded, one new test file added, five matrix rows advanced. No runtime behaviour changed, no strategy byte touched, no reachable behaviour contradicting current authority was found within the MD-B01 surface.

blocking_condition.statement: MD-B01 cannot reach DONE at any attempt while 15 of its 127 required rules are bare colon-terminated list headers and 3 more are owner pointers. 127/127 is unreachable by construction, independent of implementation quality.
blocking_condition.not_worked_around: No matrix row was reclassified to make the target reachable. DOCUMENT_CHANGE_POLICY.md forbids weakening governance to make implementation pass, and the traceability matrix is governance.

dependencies: MD-DEP-0001 and MD-DEP-0002 do not gate MD-B01
